node.title: Re^2: PERL to AWS
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I've been using [mod://AWS::CLIWrapper] for some time.

Thank you for pointing this out, it inspired me to release [mod://IPC::Run3::Shell::CLIWrapper], which is a more generic tool, but allows me to write my [id://11116531|previous example] as the following. The set-up may look a little more complicated, but the actual calls are much simplified. And since I wrote [mod://IPC::Run3::Shell], I can be certain of its behavior :-)

use warnings; use strict; use IPC::Run3::Shell::CLIWrapper; use JSON::PP qw/decode_json/; use Data::Dumper; my $s3api = IPC::Run3::Shell::CLIWrapper->new( { fail_on_stderr => 1, stdout_filter => sub { $_=decode_json($_) } }, qw/ aws --profile MyProfile --output json s3api /); my $buckets = $s3api->list_buckets; print Dumper($buckets);
